sources.title: OSS Personnel Files from Excel
sources.locator: PDF page 376, rows 25-46; visually checked against a 300 dpi render
sources.collection_name: Records of the Office of Strategic Services, Record Group 226
sources.rights_notes: All 22 printed rows remain separate. Full service or officer numbers remain private and are excluded from public claims and downloads. The literal scientific-notation-like serial text printed for Thomas M Preen remains preserved without silent correction.

sources.title: Electronic Army Serial Number Merged File, ca. 1938-1946

sources.collection_name: Records of the Selective Service System, Record Group 147
sources.rights_notes: Official unrestricted bulk data, not a Catalog API response. Full protected identifiers, coded occupations, grade codes, and raw records are not published or retained.

sources.title: Persico (Joseph E.) papers, 1943-1980
sources.locator: Box 4 discovery result for a folder indexed as Prester, Julio
sources.rights_notes: The collection finding aid is an archival lead only. The folder was not reviewed, and the finding-aid result does not establish identity, employment, or chronology.

claims.claim_text: The official Army bulk record supports a high-confidence identity match for indexed John E Preston.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact name and a nonshared protected identifier agree.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence official exact-name and protected-identifier match.
claims.temporal_assessment: Identity and Army service only; the coded occupation is not employer evidence.
claims.match_notes: No employer is inferred from the Army occupation code.

claims.claim_text: A protected identifier links the index row to an Army record for RE E HOWARD V, but the surname conflict prevents a resolved identity.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The protected identifier agrees while the indexed surname and Army name do not.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting: the identifier is specific, but no source reviewed explains the Prenzel/RE E difference.
claims.temporal_assessment: Identity conflict only; the Army record cannot support an employer claim.
claims.match_notes: The Army name is not adopted as an alias without direct documentary evidence.

claims.claim_text: A Joseph E. Persico Papers finding-aid result identifies a Box 4 folder labeled Prester, Julio.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The OSS-focused research collection contains a same-name folder that may merit archival review.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Discovery lead only; the folder contents were not reviewed and no protected identifier links it to the index row.
claims.temporal_assessment: No employment or pre-OSS chronology can be established from the finding-aid label.
claims.match_notes: Retained privately as a pull-list lead; it is not published as a biographical fact.
